xmldoc.short_description: Find visible figures placed off screen.

param_output_item.param_description: a column vector of figure objects, empty (0-by-1) when there is none.

description.p: h = findfigs() returns the figures that are visible but cannot be seen because they lie completely outside the screen.
A figure is reported when its Visible property is 'on' and its Position rectangle does not overlap the ScreenSize rectangle of the root object. Hidden figures are never reported.
findfigs only reports the figures: it does not move them. Set their Position property to bring them back on screen.
